step_name: Audit Actual Backend Readiness for ML Integration

stages.name: Schema Ingestion & Normalization
stages.details: Validated dictionary and raw JSON parsing into typed TelemetryInput / BharatiTelemetryInput contracts.

stages.name: Cold-Start Warmup Progression
stages.details: Confirmed steps 1..29 bypass neural inference and return INSUFFICIENT_DATA with null score.

stages.name: SPIKE Anomaly Classification
stages.details: Verified sudden 60C shock jump triggers ANOMALY status and SPIKE classification on both stations.

stages.name: DRIFT Ramp Anomaly Detection
stages.details: MTR drift status: ANOMALY (DRIFT), BRT drift status: ANOMALY (DRIFT).

stages.name: STUCK_VALUE Detection & Recovery
stages.details: Flatline STUCK_VALUE observed: (MTR=True, BRT=True), Recovery released stuck state: True.

stages.name: MISSING_DATA Ingestion & Buffer Flush
stages.details: MISSING quality returned MISSING_DATA and successfully flushed rolling buffer length from 30 to 0.

stages.name: Multi-Sensor Stream Isolation & Output Schema
stages.details: Verified individual sensor isolation (TEMP_001 anomaly does not bleed to PRESS_001) and all 11 canonical fields survive strict JSON serialization.
